scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,studio,admin -c green,cyan,yellow "bun run --cwd apps/server dev" "bun run --cwd apps/studio dev" "bun run --cwd apps/admin dev"
scripts.build:server: bun run build:admin && rm -rf apps/server/public && cp -r apps/admin/dist apps/server/public
scripts.build:binaries: mkdir -p dist && bun build --compile --minify apps/cli/src/index.ts --outfile dist/pwr && bun build --compile --minify apps/agent/src/index.ts --outfile dist/pwr-agent
scripts.build:all: bun run build:studio && bun run build:server && bun run build:binaries
scripts.lint: bun run format:check && oxlint --deny-warnings apps packages scripts
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n agent,studio -c green,cyan "bun run dev:agent" "bun run dev:studio"
